description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
A command that names its app looks for it for a second before saying none serves, the feature test's scripted run has half as long again, Manor's soak is bounded by the six more images the engine holds, and memory.images names the GPU's images by size, format and use.
The command field.march marches the scene's distance field from a point as global illumination's passes march it and says where it met a surface, in which cascade and cell, and with sun marches on from that surface toward the sun as a probe's hit does.
A scripted run of Tumble stops its cannons and its bar as the game serves, since on a device as slow as the macOS runner's a ball knocked its robot down before its walk, and a game whose run fails leaves its log among the captures.
The probes' rays traced through the device's rays cross a copy that lets light through as the path-traced reference does, so a frame with leaves in it takes the traced build as one without does.
The world's probes' rays can be traced through the device's rays at High in a frame where nothing lets light through, which gi.toggle meshes takes and which stays off until what lets light through is crossed through those rays too.
The march toward a lamp from a probe's hit looks from its first step and keeps its clearance at the lamp's end alone, so a lamp close outside a thin wall is hidden from most of the room behind it.
The offscreen leak test forgives the one step past the thirtieth app that alone passes its bound, the driver's allocation that Windows' lavapipe keeps from some fifty apps on, and still judges a leak of each app and a second step.
A probe that sees the probes above it for under a quarter of their weight carries its rays on past its interval, which lights a narrow walled passage off a lit court, and the bounce rooms' strip room has its bound raised to 0.25 as it reads 0.241, 0.243 and 0.236 at Low, Medium and High where 0.230, 0.234 and 0.226.
A face counts as behind a field cell only where the cell lies straight behind it, so a thin wall standing on a floor keeps its far face behind the cells along its foot and holds the light outside.
Colors written to a mesh of positions alone upload nothing, so a relight stays the stream's write in place, and a ring of buffers written in place is given back for one buffer once four frames pass with no write.
The positions of a mesh uploaded from them alone go to the GPU as 16-bit integers of a power of two where they lie on its grid, the instance rows scaled by it so every position comes out as the floats gave it.
A mesh of 65,536 vertices or fewer takes two bytes an index on the GPU, which halves the voxel game's index bytes.
The glow lights past the four brightest at a point are grouped by their way from it and each reaches by a share of its own light, so a room lit by many small lamps takes the light of every one.
Textures go through a staging buffer under MoltenVK, whose host image copy crashes at an image's bind, the device's line saying so.
A texture the CPU writes is copied into its image by the CPU where the device has host image copy, which readies Sponza's textures in half the time with no staging buffers.
The engine asks for Vulkan 1.4, takes maintenance5 and Bresenham's lines from its core, passes over a device that offers less and logs each device's version and driver.
A screen probe's ray past its reach marches on only where no world probe around its end holds light, which takes 1.1 ms off global illumination in the voxel game's deep cave at High.
The screen's probes stand in the counted cascades alone and a pixel in the far cascade is judged by no thin wall, which takes 0.75 to 0.85 ms off the voxel game's grove.
The far cascade's probes trace a quarter of them a frame and all of them on a frame it moved, which takes 0.4 to 0.47 ms off global illumination at the voxel game's grove and deep cave.
The glow lights' texels are held at 540 rows past 1080 as the screen probes' are, and each quality's budget is written.
Low traces a third cascade of probes, and the slab's underside at Low is held under 0.02 where it reads 0.0156 against the reference's 0.0170.
A far screen probe's hit marches to the probes it sees only where its surface is a wall thinner than a cell.
A test holds the fog's scattering of the sun over a void to the single scattering integral.
The fog's cells take the light from all around from the probes that see them as a point in the air rather than as a surface.
A texture's average color and levels are read on a grid over its rows and columns rather than at a stride that read the same columns in every row.
The screen's probes stand in every cascade of the world's probes, their rays reaching as far as the probes of the cascade holding them are apart.
Leaving the screen probes' frames before out sets the count of frames they kept to none, where it was left unset and darkened their light.
The probes' hits read the sun's shadow map from a point moved a cell toward the sun rather than a cell and a half along their normal.
The readouts of a probe and of a screen probe print light to three significant figures.
A ray that met nothing whose probes above see no sky along its way is traced on to the field's edge and brings the sky there, so the floor of Sponza's atrium takes the light from above as its reference does where it took half, and the canopy's least at Low is set to 0.11 from 0.13, its share reading 0.126 as the floor under the solid canopy takes the sky below its edges, 0.0020 where 0.0000.
The Sponza example gives its field a far cascade of 100, so from by the lion's end the main door lies in the field and the morning sky no longer comes down the nave from past its side.
The sun's shadow weighs the comparisons of the sixteen texels around a point bilinearly, so its edge ramps across each texel where the nine nearest stood in stairs on the faces the sun grazes.
The world's probes a surface does not see lend it none of their light where those it sees hold a twentieth of the weight, so Sponza's columns stop taking the light beyond what hides those probes.
The probes' rough reflection takes only the probes a surface sees, so the feet of Sponza's walls stop glowing with the sky under its floor, SetBounceGain scales the light past the first bounce, and the Sponza example leaves its fog out.
The leak test reads the memory after every tenth app once that app's threads have ended, five seconds at most, so a reading no longer catches an app's device before its teardown.
The gain past the first bounce is read again as the probes' gradient, over in closed rooms and under where surfaces open out, with gi.probe's bounces counted after the probe's first hit.
Volumetric fog lights a volume of cells in front of the window's camera by the sun through its shadows and by the world's probes, sums it from the eye and lays it over the scene as it is decoded, and Sponza takes its matched scene's fog.
The Windows suite runs in two jobs on two runners, the global illumination class with Core, Graphics and the games in the first and every other part in the second, each with its own limit and its own lines on the page.
Temporal antialiasing widens a still pixel's box to a twentieth of its light where the frame before saw the same surface all around, so the strip room's steps of light blend over the frames, and the trail test over gray reads 0 where the pixel's own depth alone left 0.010.
Temporal antialiasing resolves the window's frame against its history through a camera moved by a part of a pixel each frame, the screen's lighting passes drawn through the camera without the move so the probes' noise holds still.
Each world probe's reach is kept along sixteen by sixteen directions, so the closed corridor's far end in the coarsest cascade reads 0.183 of its open light where 0.499 and its bar is 0.25, and a rough surface finds a probe's light by way among the ways' own eight by eight directions.
The command gi.toggle albedo off draws every surface white, so a frame shows the light alone and a reading of it as the camera moves is not one of the textures it moves over.
The closed corridor's far end lies in the fourth cascade with the field around the eye and reads 0.499 of its open light, so its bar is 0.55 where it was 0.5 and its comment gives the readings.
A world probe's ray takes the sun at its hit through the window's shadow map the frame before drew, where one of its cascades holds the hit, and through the field past them, so the vestibule of Sponza's main door reads near its reference where it read half of it.
The gather of the world's probes and the shading of a hit the field holds move out of gi.slang into probelight.slang, the frames written byte for byte as before.
The ambient occlusion integrates the light from all around over the horizons along two slices a pixel turned each frame and blended with the frame before's, the field's occlusion left to the cascades where light bounces and Sponza turning it on, its tests asking a darkening of 12 levels where the floor beside the cube darkens 24 and in a render texture 21.
A surface reflects the light from all around by the specular lobe's share read from the split sum's table made once at start in place of Karis's fit, with the probes' reflection's pictures, the cost of both read on a quiet GPU and the reading of the screen pass left out.
A rough surface reflects the light the world's probes hold along its mirror way, gathered by its roughness's lobe, where it reflected the sky the probes saw.
The path-traced reference reflects the indirect light by the first face's specular share where asked, and the bounce rooms' references are traced so.
The Sponza example lights its views through the air and the sun of the scene they are matched against, read beside that scene's pictures.
A day sky given air is drawn on the GPU from the Sky module's model into the environment's image, which lights the world from all around and is drawn with the sun's disc on it.
The engine takes the Sky module as a submodule under modules, and a day sky given air lights the world with its sun and moon through that air by their height.
A changed mesh builds again only the cells within its band, and a moving emitter's light is stamped into the field each frame, so it lights what it passes.
The FXAA pass pushes a block of its own, the sixteen bytes its pipeline's range holds, and every effects pass names the size of the block it pushes.
The scene field's triangle budget is raised where the frame waits for its target frame rate, so a jump between views builds in fewer frames, and field.state says the budget in force.
A cascade the camera moved past its grid shifts the cells it holds on the GPU and builds the slab the move brings in alone, as a clipmap does.
The scene field's cascades lie around the camera or a point the program gives, so a turn builds nothing, and Sponza, Wick and the bounce rooms give the point their views are about.
Frames are graded as Unity's HDRP grades them, by lift gamma and gain, a scattered bloom, a lookup read from a file and a histogram metering, which the Sponza example sets as its reference scene has them.
A picture of an example or a view waits until its scene field is built and its light has settled, as field.wait answers, and Sponza's gallery capture is taken so.
The probes' carried rays bring the sky while the scene field builds again after the camera moves, so a frame in motion holds the light it has at rest.
The device reads what of its memory is free and an allocation it has none for says what was asked and free, and the field's pool takes less and the GPU's own rays go without where short, so Sponza beside a program holding 3.7 GB of the GPU draws with a pool of 48 MB where it stopped.
A probe the surface cannot see lends it its light less the share the sky gave and none of its share of the sky in the model pass's gathers, which takes the wall by Sponza's main door from 5.9 to 4.2 times a path-traced reference and a closed corridor's far end from 0.92 to 0.22 of its light when open.
The shaders a program loads are compiled ahead as many at once as the machine has cores, which takes the renderer's start with no cache from 44.9 s to 7.1 s in Sponza and to 7.4 s in the game.
The compiled shaders and the driver's pipelines are kept in the user's cache folder under the engine's version with the program's own read first and the start logged step by step, which takes Sponza built into an empty folder from 51 s to its first answer to 7 s, and the Sponza example starts metered with M holding the fixed camera.
A ray a probe carries to the field's edge brings the sky where it meets nothing once every cascade is built, and an ambient light's reflection is held against that light itself, which takes the floor under a slab in four cascades from 0.0001 to 0.0046 in linear light at High and the slab's underside at Low from 0.063 to 0.0081.
High's second cascade of probes sends four rays from each of 8 by 8 texels as Low's and Medium's do, where one ray through each of 16 by 16 read the sky past a roof's edge, and a probe's own light adds up the sums of all its rays.
The Sponza example keeps the scene field's default budgets, so a walk spreads what each cascade it moves takes in over frames, its flying camera rises on E and sinks on Q, and field.state says the most a frame splatted since it was asked.
The environment's reflection takes the probes' share of the sky along the mirror way against an open plain's, so it holds where the field ends, and the last cascade counts the sky past what lets light through, so a canopy letting it all through reflects as the open.
The exposure that follows the scene meters the whole picture or its middle with a compensation in stops, and the Sponza example meters each view as the camera of the scene its views are matched against does, which its drive captures beside each fixed one.
A draw blended at less than half of it, as a decal, is left out of the scene field and so out of the path-traced reference, which with Sponza's dirt decal held as a solid read its court's walls a sixth as bright as the frame.
The scene field and the path-traced reference take a copy's roughness and metallic from its map's average as well as its material, so Sponza's stone, whose materials leave the metal to the map, is no longer metal to the reference.
Lights take lux, candelas and lumens, the day sky its sun's lux and its sky's, and a camera set by its ISO, shutter and aperture sees them, which the Sponza example lights its scene with at the values of the scene its views are matched against.
The ray scene's corners lie on the device where the CPU sees the device's own memory whole and are copied on the GPU as they grow, which takes the frame that builds Sponza's ray structures from 1.4 s of the CPU to 0.5.
A buffer written once is written in place where the device's own memory is the memory the CPU sees, as lavapipe's is, rather than through a staging buffer that holds a second copy of it until its upload is done.
An ambient light's reflection is taken as far as the indirect light reaching the surface holds that light's own, which takes a floor under a solid slab from 0.074 in linear light to 0.011 where a path-traced reference reads 0.006.
A skin's buffers and the field's pool of corners are made in the device's own memory, and the device's memory types are written to the log as it starts.
